title: Cosmic Donkey and Skeleton
description: A skeletal figure with antlers, wearing a hat and coat, stands on a wooden balcony holding a glowing red Nike swoosh. Beside him a white-haired child and a donkey with mechanical attachments look over the railing toward a swirling cosmic vortex in the night sky.
